entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-04
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Intellisense behaves differently based if the class or record has required properties #81547
  • using the intellisense suggestion, 'collection initialized can be simplified', 'Find All References' does not report the reference. #81546
  • CS0592 for NotNullWhen on extension property #81543
  • Passing in parameters in constructor of read-only struct shouldn't be allowed #81539

Closed

  • [Suggestion] Emit `[DoesNotReturn]` on generated `ThrowSwitchExpressionException` for switch expressions Roslyn does not consider exhaustive #81412
  • We should have a way to assert the shape of the bound tree before and after lowering #16057
    Backlog
  • Can't raise errors from source generators via WarningsAsErrors #49219
    Backlog
  • Overload resolution failure results in nonsensical error about not being able to convert "string to string" #12933
    Backlog
  • Misleading error message #43920
    Backlog
  • Possible Span<T>/ROS<T> overload resolution bug with implicit conversion (or missing priority increase for MemoryMarshal.AsRef) #81528
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11303.115 #81538
  • [runtime-async] Roslyn loads stale value with compound right shift involving await on RHS #81212
    18.3

PullRequests

Created

  • Build our libraries against net10.0 #81545
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Ref-safety for `with(...)` elements. #81542
    Needs API Review

Merged

  • Update Roslyn LSP server to .net10 #81508
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Assert shape of the bound tree #81486
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • GH Workflow Performance Validation #81544
  • Prefer expanded form for error reporting when params arguments are convertible #81276
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Add IOp support for `with(...)` elements. #81427
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Do not copy hoisted locals or parameters unnecessarily #81227
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async, Next

Updated

  • Dismiss and suppress gray text proposals for the duration of the event hookup session #81526
    Area-IDE, Community
  • Use ArrayExpansion for fixed buffer fields #81536
    Area-Interactive, Community
  • Generate docs - fix an issue where the suggestion session was being overtaken #81537
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Further clean up Roslyn's package load #80598
    Area-IDE
  • Ensure calls to OOP for source-generator purposes see the exact same Solution-snapshot-instances across all calls they make #81529
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Unsafe evolution: add `MemorySafetyRules` attribute #81441
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Fix Hot Reload checksum mismatch for files without UTF-8 BOM #81480
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Optimize CopyRefAssembly task by checking file size and timestamp before MVID extraction #80635
    Area-Compilers
  • Emit async-iterators with runtime-async when possible #81314
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Implement exhaustiveness check for Union types #81442
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Closed Class Hierarchies, Feature - Unions
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #81478
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Do not report parse errors for '#:' in miscellaneous files #81385
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Feature - Run File
